items.name: 2 Rounds of FMC in Rzeszów 2023

venue.name: Private residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors after registration ends

items.information:
Zapraszamy na dwie rundy FMa w Rzeszowie!

Zwróć uwagę, że na tych zawodach NIE będą organizowane standardowe konkurencje takie jak 3x3.

Druga runda odbędzie się jedynie jeżeli w konkurencji weźmie udział 8 zawodników.

Zawody odbędą się w Rzeszowie, w dzielnicy Wilkowyja, w pobliżu wypożyczalni sprzętu budowlanego RENTA.
Dokładny adres zawodów zostanie podany zarejestrowanym zawodnikom.

Wszystkie informacje na poszczególne tematy odnoszące się zawodów można znaleźć w odpowiednich zakładkach. W razie pytań należy kontaktować się z organizatorami.

---------
 
We invite you to two rounds of FMC in Rzeszów!

Please note that standard events such as 3x3 will NOT be held at this event.

Second round will only take place if 8 competitors participate in an event.

The competition will take place in Rzeszów, in the Wilkowyja district, near the RENTA construction equipment rental.
The exact address of the competition will be given to registered competitors

All information on individual topics related to the competition can be found in the appropriate tabs. If you have any questions, please contact the organizers.

items.name: Kirkkonummen Kuutiokemut 2023
items.information:
No shoes inside the venue. Every indoor area apart from the first floor and the second floor bathrooms is restricted. This will be monitored using security footage if needed.
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
The schedule may be subject to change, so make sure to be at the venue at least 30 minutes before your scheduled events.

Ei kenkiä sisätiloissa. Ensimmäistä kerrosta ja toisen kerroksen vessoja pidemmälle ei saa mennä. Tätä seurataan tarvittaessa valvontakameroiden tallenteilta.
Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Aikataulu voi muuttua päivän aikana, joten ole paikalla vähintään 30 minuuttia ennen lajejasi.

items.name: SnoCo Veterans Day Weekend 2023
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoVeteransDayWeekend2023#21634-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Even though we don't expect this to be an issue, please be aware that depending on the amount of competitors, we might need to change the amount of rounds or amount of competitors that can procceed to future rounds. This is in compliance to regulations [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m) and [9p](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p)

If the events that you are competing in are on only one day of the competition, you are still welcome, but not required to attend both days of the competition.

We might run ahead of schedule throughout the competition. Please be present up to 30 minutes before any event that you are scheduled to compete in.

[![PNW Cubing](https://www.pnwcubing.com/uploads/1/9/8/7/19877007/editor/pnwcubing-transparent-01.png?1639634180)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing)

items.name: Virginia Championship 2023
items.information:
This is the Virginia championship, but anyone can compete regardless of their state of residence. See more information on the [Championship Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VirginiaChampionship2023#32413-championship-eligibility).

This event will take place on the arena side of the brand new [Henrico Sports & Events Center](https://henricosea.com/facilities-venues/henrico-sports-and-events-center/).  Please see the Venue Information tab for information on where to park and what doors to use.  Also, please note that outside food and beverage is not permitted.


This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org).
